identify: Very small red mites live on the leaves.
The leaves turn reddish brown and bronze in colour.
damage: Heavy attack makes silken webbing on the leaves. The leaves wither and dry. Flower and fruit formation is affected.

cultural: Do field sanitation and remove the affected plants.
Plant tall border crops such as maize and sorghum.
biological: Protect predatory mites, ladybird beetles and lacewings in the field.
